commits.message: refactor(storage): streamline resolveAvatarsFileProxyUrl function signature
commits.message_full:
refactor(storage): streamline resolveAvatarsFileProxyUrl function signature

This commit simplifies the function signature of `resolveAvatarsFileProxyUrl` by consolidating the parameter declaration into a single line. This change enhances code readability without altering the function's behavior.

commits.message: feat(auth): integrate Google One Tap authentication into landing and auth layouts
commits.message_full:
feat(auth): integrate Google One Tap authentication into landing and auth layouts

This commit adds the Google One Tap component to both the landing page and auth layouts, enhancing the user authentication experience. Additionally, it refactors the LoginFormMailOTP component to remove the direct use of Google One Tap hooks, streamlining the authentication process. The SessionProvider component is updated to improve session handling, ensuring a more efficient user session management.

commits.message: feat(captcha, newsletter): integrate Turnstile captcha and newsletter signing secret management
commits.message_full:
feat(captcha, newsletter): integrate Turnstile captcha and newsletter signing secret management

This commit introduces the integration of Cloudflare Turnstile for captcha functionality in the password reset process, enhancing security. It also implements a new newsletter signing secret management system, allowing for the configuration of a dedicated signing secret for newsletter tokens. Updates include modifications to the environment configuration, API routes, and frontend components to support these features, improving overall application security and user experience.

commits.message: feat(auth): implement custom session handling with avatar proxy URL support
commits.message_full:
feat(auth): implement custom session handling with avatar proxy URL support

This commit introduces a custom session handling mechanism in the authentication process, allowing the inclusion of an avatar proxy URL in the session data. The changes involve updates to the auth middleware, session context, and various components to utilize the new avatar proxy URL, enhancing the user experience by providing a dynamic avatar URL based on the session configuration. Additionally, the configuration and schema have been updated to accommodate this new feature.

commits.message: chore(docs): remove outdated security audit and admin user ban design documents
commits.message_full:
chore(docs): remove outdated security audit and admin user ban design documents

This commit deletes the `security-audit-2026-06-remediation.md` and `2026-04-25-admin-user-ban-design.md` files, which are no longer relevant to the current project scope. This cleanup helps maintain an organized documentation structure and ensures that only up-to-date information is available for developers.

commits.message: feat(config): update wrangler configuration for compatibility and routing
commits.message_full:
feat(config): update wrangler configuration for compatibility and routing

This commit enhances the `wrangler.jsonc` configuration by updating the compatibility date to 2026-09-30 and adding necessary compatibility flags. It also introduces a custom route for the domain `demo.musemvp.com`, while refining existing settings for better deployment management.

commits.message: feat(config): add Next.js configuration with security headers and output settings
commits.message_full:
feat(config): add Next.js configuration with security headers and output settings

This commit introduces a new `next.config.ts` file that configures Next.js with baseline security headers and output settings for standalone builds. It also integrates MDX and internationalization plugins, enhancing the application's configuration capabilities. Additionally, the `postcss.config.mjs` file is added for Tailwind CSS support, and several scripts are updated or removed to streamline the build process.

commits.message: chore(env): add default locale to example environment variables
commits.message_full:
chore(env): add default locale to example environment variables

This commit updates the .env.local.example file to include a new environment variable for the default locale, enhancing the configuration options available for developers.

commits.message_full: fix(contact-form): update subject line for clarity

commits.message: feat(settings): implement admin settings management and database schema for application settings
commits.message_full:
feat(settings): implement admin settings management and database schema for application settings

This commit introduces a new admin settings management feature, allowing for the retrieval and updating of application settings through a dedicated API. It includes the addition of a new `app_setting` table in the database schema to store settings, along with corresponding queries for listing, upserting, and deleting settings. The frontend has been updated to integrate with this new functionality, enhancing the overall configuration capabilities for administrators.

commits.message: chore(env): update example environment variables for Waffo pricing plans
commits.message_full:
chore(env): update example environment variables for Waffo pricing plans

This commit adds new environment variable entries for Waffo pricing plans in the .env.local.example file, including monthly, yearly, and lifetime IDs. This update ensures that developers have the latest configuration options available for integration with the Waffo billing gateway.
